# Code of Conduct

Qdrant Native Portable aims to keep collaboration professional, respectful, and technically focused.

## Expected behavior

Participants are expected to communicate respectfully, give and receive constructive feedback, respect different levels of experience and viewpoints, keep discussions relevant to the project, and protect other people's privacy. Never publish another person's credentials, API keys, tokens, provider secrets, private data, or sensitive runtime information.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, discriminatory or demeaning language, sustained disruption, impersonation, deliberate disclosure of private information, or other behavior inappropriate in a professional engineering community is not accepted.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, project discussions, and public interactions in which someone is representing the project. Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content, close or lock discussions, reject contributions, or restrict participation when needed to protect the community and project.

For a sensitive conduct report, do not open a public issue. Contact `i.am@dangkhoa.dev` with enough context to evaluate the report. Reports will be handled with discretion to the extent reasonably possible.

## Attribution

This policy is informed by the principles of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/) while using project-specific wording and enforcement guidance.
